Info_AuraRadius: AuraRadius: EMI aura radius in meters.
Info_AuraConvulsionChance: AuraConvulsionChance: percent chance per aura roll to start convulsions.
Info_BurstConvulsionChance: BurstConvulsionChance: percent chance that the energy burst uses ragdoll convulsions.
Info_AuraPlayerDamage: AuraPlayerDamagePerSecond: health damage per second inside the aura. 0 disables player health damage.
Info_AuraElectronicsDamage: AuraElectronicsDamagePercent: percent of an electrical item's max health removed per glitch pulse.
Info_BurstPlayerDamage: BurstPlayerDamage: direct health damage from the EMI energy burst.
Info_BurstElectronicsDamage: BurstElectronicsDamagePercent: percent of an electrical item's max health removed by the energy burst.
